Human annotation and evaluation workers have separate optional dashed connections.
LoRA, QLoRA, Abliteration, IFEval, MT-Bench and HarmBench labels and all seven citation IDs checked.

interpretation: Hardware drawings are schematic and cost tags describe resource drivers, not universal prices or speedup factors.
The Base copy icon represents another load of the same checkpoint, not another pretraining run.
Benchmark names are examples, not a claim that the repository executed them.
Route-specific data, method limitations, full cost expressions and complete citations are in README.md and workflow_costs.json.
